x-card.description: Databases, measurements and SQL or InfluxQL reads of InfluxDB 3, 2.x and 1.x. Writes wait for approval.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: The server's address with https:// and its port, optionally with a path prefix. Plain http:// only to this computer.

version.title: Server
version.description: The API GateRook uses; Test connection checks it against the server. InfluxDB Cloud Serverless and Cloud Dedicated answer SQL only over Arrow Flight: choose InfluxDB 2.x for their InfluxQL and write APIs.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: InfluxDB 2.x only: the organization of the buckets. InfluxDB OSS needs it for writes; InfluxDB Cloud takes it from the token.

databases.title: Databases
databases.description: The databases agents may use (buckets on InfluxDB 2.x); * matches any characters, such as iot_*. Empty: every database the credentials may read.

method.title: Authentication
method.description: InfluxDB 3 and 2.x sign in with a token, InfluxDB 1.x with a username and password. No authentication only for a server that checks none, never on prod.

token.title: API token
token.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. Prefer a token that may only read the databases agents use.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Limits of one read and one write, and a private CA. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

maxRows.title: Rows per query
maxRows.description: The most rows one read returns; the endpoint's row limit applies as well.

maxResponseKb.title: Response size
maxResponseKb.description: The most data one answer carries; a longer answer is cut and says so.

maxWritePoints.title: Points per write
maxWritePoints.description: The most points one approved write holds. A write is also at most 1 MiB of line protocol.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate comes from a private CA.
